moves.label: Quick Chakra Jab
moves.description: Fast high chakra jab with a short active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Short standing punch arc fits Sakura's chakra-strength style.

moves.label: Low Heel Sweep
moves.description: Slow low heel sweep with a long active arc and weak left tracking.
moves.reason: Low kick swings through the leg line and matches existing weak-left tracking.

moves.label: Twin Chakra Assault
moves.description: Slow mid two-part assault with a long active follow-through and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Two-part standing sequence finishes with a body-height chakra-strength hit.

moves.label: Chakra Uppercut Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with long active lift and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Upward swing and authored launch height support launcher naming.

moves.label: Low Aerial Sweep
moves.description: Slow low jumping sweep that ends crouched after a brief active hit.
moves.reason: Low route flips upward and settles into crouch, matching authored flags.

moves.label: Low Driving Sweep
moves.description: Slow low knockdown sweep with long active reach and almost no recovery.
moves.reason: Low driving kick is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Monster Strength Crush
moves.description: Quick mid knockdown crush with huge active pressure and short recovery.
moves.reason: Big chakra-strength strike reads as Sakura's heavy crush ender.

moves.label: Crouch Chakra Hook
moves.description: Quick mid crouch hook with long active pressure and fast recovery.
moves.reason: Full-crouch route swings through a body-height chakra arc.

moves.label: Crouch Chakra Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid crouch launcher with long active lift and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Crouching lift has authored launch height.

moves.label: Overdrive Chakra Jab
moves.description: Steady high overdrive jab with a modest active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive route uses the high chakra-jab animation.

moves.label: Chakra Aura Drive
moves.description: Slow special knockdown drive with long active chakra pressure.
moves.reason: Aura-backed strike is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: Sidestep Low Vault
moves.description: Fast low jumping sidestep vault with huge active leg pressure.
moves.reason: Sidestep kick leaves the ground and attacks low with weak-left tracking.

moves.label: Ducking Chakra Jab
moves.description: Slow high ducking jab with a tiny active hit and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab uses the same high chakra-jab frames.

moves.label: Ducking Low Vault
moves.description: Fast low jumping vault with huge active leg pressure and weak left tracking.
moves.reason: Down kick shares the low airborne vault animation.

moves.label: Cherry Blossom Tornado
moves.description: Fast mid jumping tornado launcher with a long active spin and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Large airborne spinning arc supports tornado, launcher, and jump properties.

moves.label: Diagonal Low Vault
moves.description: Fast low diagonal vault with huge active leg pressure and weak left tracking.
moves.reason: Down-forward kick is the same low jumping vault family.

moves.label: Forward Chakra Punch
moves.description: Slow mid forward punch with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Forward input produces a body-height chakra-strength strike.

moves.label: Advancing Low Vault
moves.description: Fast low advancing vault with huge active leg pressure and weak left tracking.
moves.reason: Forward kick shares the low jumping vault animation.

moves.label: Chakra Quick Jab
moves.description: Steady high quarter-circle jab with a modest active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab repeats the high chakra-jab animation.

moves.label: Cherry Blossom Low Vault
moves.description: Fast low quarter-circle vault with huge active leg pressure and weak left tracking.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle kick uses the same low airborne vault family.
